name: Napa County Library Databases
description: Free access to research databases and digital resources with Napa County library card
fullDescription: Napa County Library provides free access to research databases and digital resources for all cardholders.
whatTheyOffer:
- Research databases
- Ebooks, audiobooks, and streaming (Libby, Hoopla, Kanopy)
- Digital magazines and newspapers (New York Times, Wall Street Journal, PressReader)
- Learning resources and live homework help (Learning Express, Brainfuse HelpNow)
- Consumer and business information (Consumer Reports, Value Line, AtoZdatabases)
- Local newspaper archives (Napa Valley Register, San Francisco Chronicle)
howToGetIt:
1. Get a Napa County Library card (free for residents)
2. Visit the library's A-Z Resources page
3. Browse available resources
4. Sign in with your library card
5. Access content on any device
keywords: Napa County Library, Napa, databases, research, ebooks, audiobooks, magazines, local newspaper archives, consumer information, business databases, homework help
